contractGuidance.markdown:
# AGENTS.md — TimeCapsule project context

This guidance applies only to the TimeCapsule mobile application contract in this Atlas. It does not describe development of the Project Atlas website.

## Current specification and authority

The user authorized applying the finalized TimeCapsule_Atlas.json, unifying Detailed Design identifiers and resolving the remaining design decisions. Revision 13 imported the finalized records; revision 14 removed superseded detailed-design records and their obsolete relationships. The resulting contract contains 112 items, 378 relationships and 9 source records. Re-read current data before relying on these counts.

Use the current node specification, explicit relationships and source records. The original project documents remain historical provenance; current authorized specification decisions take precedence over their earlier alternatives. Export-preparation notes stating that the package had not been applied describe the earlier file-creation stage; the import and cleanup revisions record its application.

Canonical identifiers:
- FR: functional requirement.
- NFR: non-functional requirement.
- ARC: Architectural Design.
- DD: Detailed Design.
- AC: acceptance criterion.
- T: planned test.

Use one Design node category, with architectural_design and detailed_design tags. Architectural designs use ARC-01 through ARC-07. All detailed designs use DD-01 through DD-28; do not create separate identifier families for decisions, quality details or flows. Existing DD-01 and DD-02 retain their meanings.

Every active item must participate in at least one requirement → architectural design → detailed design → acceptance criterion → test trace. Preserve the logical trace when editing identifiers.

## Domain boundaries and finalized design decisions

- Accounts and account-based delivery to self or another registered user are MVP. Use Firebase email/password Auth, public Auth UID recipient codes, exact-code profile lookup and explicit recipient confirmation.
- Content is text and/or one original JPEG/PNG photo of at most 5 MiB. An optional title is disclosed as visible while locked. Direct camera capture, compression and additional media types are outside the required input path.
- Time, location and current time-plus-location AND locks are supported. Store UTC instants with creation IANA zone IDs; final publication requires a future server time. First unlock requires online backend authorization.
- Current location uses distance ≤150 m, sample age ≤60 seconds and reported accuracy ≤100 m. A prior visit does not latch a combined condition. The official client's location check is the documented trust boundary; no server-verifiable physical presence or anti-spoofing guarantee is claimed.
- Confirmed unlock is permanent. A→B sender viewing is separate from recipient access. For A→A, recipient locking overrides sender privileges, including protected text, photos and app-managed caches.
- A send freezes one snapshot and capsule ID. Required photo upload must be acknowledged before atomic Firestore publication. Unknown outcomes preserve the same ID/path/digest; absence alone does not prove a prior write cannot publish. Edited restart requires definite unpublished failure.
- Use the specified Firebase Auth/Firestore/Storage service family, Blaze billing selection, Seoul resource region, native Android Views and pinned dependencies. These are design selections, not proof that a live service has been provisioned or integration tested.
- Firestore uses memory-only caching. Account-scoped private retained files and small DataStore markers/journals support authorized offline re-view. First unlock cannot be authorized by cached state. Logout/switch purges protected content and invalidates old callbacks.
- Supported verification triggers are app-open, foreground resume, detail opening and explicit retry. Install no alarms, geofences, boot receivers, periodic polling, background location or FCM for this MVP.
- After a supported check confirms first unlock, attempt a generic local notification when permission permits. Notification receipt is independent of unlock correctness; closed-app and exact-time delivery are not guaranteed.
- Photo acquisition uses Photo Picker on API 33+ and document selection on API 26–32, with a bounded private copy for stable retry. Follow the specified uncertain-send and orphan-cleanup boundaries.
- External links/QR sharing, advanced social features, audio, one-view destruction, always-on services and GPS anti-spoofing remain outside this MVP.

## Evidence discipline

Specification finalization, implementation progress, test execution and product scope are separate. The contracts are finalized. At the owner's initialization on 1 November 2026, all 18 requirements and 35 designs are not_started, all 14 acceptance criteria are not_verified, and all 45 tests are not_run. These are initial progress values, not permanent constraints; read current item statuses before later edits.

The native wireframe's earlier APK build and 16 local model tests do not constitute production Firebase, security-rule, physical-location or cross-device passes. Android Studio GUI import and API 36 installation/launch were not verified. Preserve those limits until actual evidence supports an update.

A real test result records expected and actual observations, tester/date, Android build, backend/rules version, device/environment and evidence. An Atlas revision records a documentation decision, not an unobserved implementation pass or team ratification.

## Completion and WIP status policy

Status choices are configured separately for each node category in Atlas settings, with English/Korean labels and shared colors. Architectural and Detailed Design remain one Design category and share the same progress workflow.

- Requirement: not_started → in_progress → awaiting_verification → satisfied. The initial label “Finalized · Not started” means the requirement text is finalized but software fulfillment has not begun. Satisfied requires evidence that the implemented behavior meets the whole requirement and its applicable linked acceptance criteria/tests.
- Design: not_started → in_progress → awaiting_verification → verified. The initial label “Finalized · Not implemented” means the design is finalized but its realization has not begun. Verified means its components/interfaces/logic are implemented and the applicable linked checks support them. An architectural design is not complete merely because its document or one related detailed design is complete.
- Acceptance criterion: not_verified → in_verification → passed or failed. Passed requires observed evidence that the criterion is met; its finalized wording is not a pass.
- Test: not_run → running → passed or failed. A plan, code stub, prior prototype/model test or another linked test does not count as executing this test. Record the actual execution evidence.
- Every category also offers blocked. Record the concrete blocker and next action in the item context before using it. Blocked does not mean completed.
- Neutral slate indicates the initial state, blue active work, purple awaiting verification, green evidenced completion/pass, red failure and amber a blocker.
- Status changes are manual, item by item. Do not infer completion of neighboring nodes or cascade a pass automatically along relationships. Reopen affected completed items when new evidence invalidates completion.
- The 1 November 2026 initialization changes no functional requirement, design behavior, acceptance threshold or test procedure. Historical wireframe/build evidence remains provenance and does not establish production implementation progress.

title.en: Recipient lookup, delivery and same-operation retry

summary.en: Recipient is the sender or a registered other account. Other-recipient selection uses exact public UID-based code lookup, a minimal display name and explicit confirmation. Blank/nonexistent code is rejected; network/permission lookup failure says *lookup unavailable* rather than *not registered*. `SENT` means all required photo upload(s) **and** a finalized, recipient-queryable capsule record have acknowledged backend completion. It **does not** require an actual second-account query during every send or the recipient opening the app; A→B query availability is verified by tests. Firestore local pending writes and ambiguous timeouts do not count as `SENT`. Retry of an unchanged logical operation reuses `capsuleId` and media path; a newly created separate identical-content capsule is allowed. New received capsules become discoverable on recipient app-open/sync; immediate offline/background receipt is not guaranteed.
summary.ko: 본인 또는 다른 등록 계정으로 전송한다. 다른 수신자는 정확한 UID 코드 조회와 이름 확인 후 선택한다. 사진 업로드 및 수신 목록에서 조회 가능한 최종 원격 기록의 ACK가 있어야 SENT이며, 수신자 앱 실행은 요구하지 않는다. 결과 불명은 같은 ID로 조회 후 처리한다.

overview.en: Recipient is the sender or a registered other account. Other-recipient selection uses exact public UID-based code lookup, a minimal display name and explicit confirmation. Blank/nonexistent code is rejected; network/permission lookup failure says *lookup unavailable* rather than *not registered*. `SENT` means all required photo upload(s) **and** a finalized, recipient-queryable capsule record have acknowledged backend completion. It **does not** require an actual second-account query during every send or the recipient opening the app; A→B query availability is verified by tests. Firestore local pending writes and ambiguous timeouts do not count as `SENT`. Retry of an unchanged logical operation reuses `capsuleId` and media path; a newly created separate identical-content capsule is allowed. New received capsules become discoverable on recipient app-open/sync; immediate offline/background receipt is not guaranteed.
overview.ko: 수신자는 발신자 자신 또는 다른 등록 계정이다. 다른 수신자는 공개 UID 기반 코드의 정확한 조회, 최소한의 표시 이름, 명시적인 확인으로 선택한다. 빈 코드·존재하지 않는 코드는 거부한다. 네트워크·권한으로 조회에 실패한 경우에는 *미등록*이 아니라 *조회 불가*로 안내한다. `SENT`는 필요한 사진 업로드 전체와, 최종 확정되어 수신자 쿼리로 조회할 수 있는 캡슐 기록이 모두 백엔드 완료 응답을 받은 상태를 뜻한다. 매 전송마다 실제 두 번째 계정으로 쿼리하거나 수신자가 앱을 열어야 하는 것은 **아니다**. A→B 조회 가능성은 테스트로 검증한다. Firestore 로컬 대기 쓰기와 결과가 불명확한 타임아웃은 `SENT`가 아니다. 변경되지 않은 논리적 작업의 재시도는 같은 `capsuleId`와 미디어 경로를 재사용한다. 동일한 내용으로 별도로 새 캡슐을 만드는 것은 허용한다. 새로 받은 캡슐은 수신자가 앱을 열거나 동기화할 때 발견하며, 즉각적인 오프라인/백그라운드 수신은 보장하지 않는다.

title.en: Future time condition and authoritative time

summary.en: Time-lock `unlockAt` is a future UTC instant plus creation-time-zone ID for display; a later device time-zone change does not change the stored instant. The app may give immediate local validation, but **final publication must reject `unlockAt ≤ authoritative backend request time`**. The backend does not grant first time unlock before `unlockAt`; at/after the instant, successful online server-authorized evaluation allows it. Moving the device clock cannot unlock early. Notification delivery has no bearing on correctness.
summary.ko: 잠금 시각을 절대 UTC instant와 생성 시간대 ID로 저장한다. 최종 발행 시 서버 시각 기준 현재·과거의 unlockAt을 거부하며 최초 잠금 해제에도 서버 시각을 사용한다. 기기 시각·시간대 변경으로 조기 해제되지 않고 알림 수신이 해제 조건이 아니다.

overview.en: Time-lock `unlockAt` is a future UTC instant plus creation-time-zone ID for display; a later device time-zone change does not change the stored instant. The app may give immediate local validation, but **final publication must reject `unlockAt ≤ authoritative backend request time`**. The backend does not grant first time unlock before `unlockAt`; at/after the instant, successful online server-authorized evaluation allows it. Moving the device clock cannot unlock early. Notification delivery has no bearing on correctness.
overview.ko: 시간 잠금의 `unlockAt`은 미래의 UTC 시각이며, 표시용 생성 시간대 ID를 함께 보존한다. 나중에 기기의 시간대를 바꾸어도 저장된 절대 시각은 바뀌지 않는다. 앱은 즉시 로컬 유효성 검사를 할 수 있지만, **최종 발행 시 `unlockAt ≤ 권위 있는 백엔드 요청 시각`이면 반드시 거부한다**. 백엔드는 `unlockAt` 전에 최초 시간 잠금 해제를 허용하지 않는다. 해당 시각 이후에는 온라인에서 서버가 승인하는 평가가 성공하면 해제할 수 있다. 기기 시계를 바꾸어도 조기 해제할 수 없다. 알림 전달 여부는 정확성에 영향을 주지 않는다.

summary.en: Location target is the point selected on a map or the device's current location, stored as latitude/longitude. Initial MVP rule: current distance ≤150 m, current sample age ≤60 seconds, reported accuracy ≤100 m, no dwell, ENTER-oriented hint; a geofence event alone is **not** proof of presence. Invalid/stale/uncertain/outside reading, denied permission or disabled service do not unlock. Provide retry/guidance. First unlock requires online backend confirmation. Physical-device validation may propose tuning, but thresholds are not silently changed. Client-trusted location is an acknowledged MVP limitation; anti-spoofing is out of scope.

overview.en: Location target is the point selected on a map or the device's current location, stored as latitude/longitude. Invalid/stale/uncertain/outside reading, denied permission or disabled service do not unlock. Provide retry/guidance. First unlock requires online backend confirmation. Physical-device validation may propose tuning, but thresholds are not silently changed. Client-trusted location is an acknowledged MVP limitation; anti-spoofing is out of scope.
overview.ko: 위치 목표는 지도에서 선택한 지점 또는 기기의 현재 위치이며 위도/경도로 저장한다. 초기 MVP 규칙은 현재 거리 ≤150 m, 현재 위치 표본의 경과 시간 ≤60초, 보고된 정확도 ≤100 m이다. 체류 시간 조건은 없고 ENTER 중심 이벤트는 힌트일 뿐이며, 지오펜스 이벤트 하나만으로 실제 도착을 증명할 수 **없다**. 유효하지 않음·오래됨·불확실함·범위 밖인 위치, 권한 거부 또는 위치 서비스 비활성화 시 해제하지 않는다. 재시도/안내를 제공한다. 최초 해제에는 온라인 백엔드 확인이 필요하다. 실기기 검증 후 조정을 제안할 수 있지만 임계값을 임의로 바꾸지 않는다. 클라이언트가 제공하는 위치를 신뢰한다는 점은 명시된 MVP 한계이며, 위치 위조 방지는 범위 밖이다.

overview.en:
- Use Kotlin Android UI/ViewModel → CapsuleRepository → Firebase, location, media and local-state adapters.
- Repository APIs cover session, getRecipient(uid), publish(frozenOperation), reconcile(id), lists, verifyUnlock(id) and readContent(id).
  - publish(frozenOperation) is required to fix the snapshot of the capsule, and in case of sending failure (due to network issue or something), sending the capsule in new ID repetitively could create a risk of generating duplicate capsules. Therefore, the capsule is kept in the same ID constantly. 
  - reconcile(id) is required for app to check if the sent capsule is posted to the server.
  - Example of using those methods is as below:
  ```text
  Start app
  └─ session
       > Check current user A

  A types B's UID
  └─ getRecipient(B_UID)
      > Check current display name of user B

  A sends capsule
  └─ publish(frozenOperation)
       > Post capsule

  Unsure of send result 
  └─ reconcile(capsuleId)
       > Check the result via server

  B starts app
  └─ lists
       > Checks received capsules

  B attempts to open the locked capsule
  └─ verifyUnlock(capsuleId)
       > Check unlock condition and request for server approval

  Content view opens after server approval
  └─ readContent(capsuleId)
       > Access protected photo/contents
  ```
- Return typed success, invalid, denied, unavailable and outcome-unknown results; scope every asynchronous result to a session generation. (Resolving race conditions, such as user A logging out and at the same time user B logs in, and user B's authenticated screen is shown to user A)
- Keep ConditionEvaluator pure, state observable and notification scheduling separate from authorization. Basically, make responsibility of those 3 independent to each other. 

### Role of CapsuleRepository
- A layer responsible for coordinating activities(caused by ViewModel from user) involved with data
- No matter which ViewModel executes activities that require data, it'll be done through CapsuleRepository

title.en: Metadata, protected content and query schema

summary.en: Store recipientDirectory/{uid}: uid/displayName; capsules/{id}: participants, optional title, lock fields, hasPhoto/photoPath, createdAt and unlock state.
summary.ko: 공개 수신 코드 레코드, 캡슐 메타데이터, 별도 보호 본문, Cloud Storage 사진, 계정별 로컬 작업·검증 마커를 구분한다. 송·수신 목록은 UID로 제한된 쿼리이며 Rules는 필드 단위 마스킹을 지원하지 않는다.

overview.en:
Data contents are stored following the structure below:
```
recipientDirectory/{uid}
 ├─ uid
 └─ displayName

capsules/{capsuleId}
 ├─ senderId / recipientId
 ├─ optional title
 ├─ lock conditions
 └─ unlock state

protectedContent/{capsuleId}
 └─ message text

capsuleMedia/{senderUid}/{capsuleId}/original
 └─ original photo
```
- Store recipientDirectory/{uid}: uid/displayName; capsules/{id}: participants, optional title, lock fields, hasPhoto/photoPath, createdAt and unlock state.
- Store message text separately in protectedContent/{id}; store the photo at capsuleMedia/{senderUid}/{id}/original without public download-token URLs.
- Use TIME|LOCATION|BOTH with UTC Timestamp/creationZone, WGS84 coordinates and radiusM=150 as applicable; use a random stable capsule ID and immutable snapshot digest.
- Create metadata/content together with matching IDs and digest; recipient lookups are exact get, and lists filter senderId or recipientId by active UID.

overview.en:
- Below is the summary of access permission for protected contents of the capsule, when condition for unlocking the capsule isn't satisified.

| User | A→B  Locked Capsule | A→A Locked Capsule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sender A | O | X |
| Receiver B | X | - |
| Arbitrary C | X | X |
| Logged out user | X | X |
- Use Firebase Auth email/password; directory owner maintains only its UID/displayName, authenticated exact reads are allowed(Can check displayName of that user with that uid), and directory listing is denied. (All-user listing view is prohibited)
- Participant metadata reads require authenticated sender or recipient; protected reads require (sender==uid AND sender!=recipient) OR (recipient==uid AND unlocked).
- Firestore rules validate...  via getAfter, and only the recipient may make the one-way unlock transition.
  - field types: "Are the data in right type?"
  - allowed keys: "Are allowed fields only included?"
  - ownership : "Is the data provider/user is the authenticated provider/sender/user?"
  - recipient existence: "Does the recipient account exist corresponding to the given UID?"
  - lock shape: "Is the structure of the lock correct?"
  - paired create: "Are the capsule metadata and the protected contents created together?"
- Storage rules mirror the protected-read predicate through Firestore, restrict upload MIME/size/path, and prevent replacement/deletion after publication; physical location remains official-client trust.

summary.en: Persist a frozen operation and stable ID/path before upload; await required Storage ACK, then atomically create metadata and protected text through Firestore.
summary.ko: 초안 스냅샷과 ID를 고정하고 사진 업로드 ACK 후 Firestore batch로 최종 기록을 생성한다. 결과 불명은 같은 ID로 조회 후 재시도한다. Storage와 Firestore는 원자적 단일 트랜잭션이 아니다.

overview.en:
- Persist a frozen operation and stable ID/path before upload; await required Storage ACK, then atomically create metadata and protected text through Firestore.
- Use create-only rules(i.e. no modification allowed) and a digest of the consistent immutable payload; successful server ACK or a matching server-fetched published record resolves SENT.
- Serialize attempts per ID; after timeout or process death remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until reconciliation establishes publication or an explicit terminal rejection with no outstanding write.
- An absent server read alone does not cancel a queued write; after process restart, unchanged replay keeps ID/path/digest and reconciles already-exists, while edited restart requires definite failure and a new ID.

overview.en:
- TIME/BOTH creation requires unlockAt > request.time; recipient unlock requires request.time >= unlockAt and changes only unlocked plus server-timestamped unlockedAt.
- LOCATION/BOTH obtains a fresh foreground Location, checking finite coordinates, nonnegative accuracy/age, age≤60 s, accuracy≤100 m and distance≤150 m in the current attempt.
- For BOTH, submit the current qualifying sample decision to the same online unlock attempt; reject/reset local intent after expiration, process death or network loss instead of queuing a later location unlock.
- Use an online transaction with server-read metadata and rules enforcement; never authorize from pending/cache writes; reconcile uncertain results, and never reverse a confirmed unlock.

summary.en: Choose the already documented memory-only Firestore cache fallback plus a small explicit UID-scoped app-private retained-content store; add no Room database.
summary.ko: 최초 해제에 로컬 캐시를 신뢰하지 않는다. 현재 UID로 오프라인 재열람을 제한하고 로그아웃 시 보호 파일·리스너를 정리한다. Firestore 디스크 캐시 격리를 테스트하고 실패 시 메모리 캐시로 전환한다.

overview.en:
- Utilize memory-only Firestore cache plus a small explicit UID-scoped app-private retained-content store; add no Room database(We don't need it).
  - memory-only Firestore cache is required for data that's viewed via Firestore only save to cache temporarily rather than automatically persisting it in disk. 
  - Through UID-scoped App-private Retained-content Store, unlocked contents/photos should be viewable. like:
  ```text
  App Private Storage/
  └─ retained-content/
      └─ UID_A/
          ├─ capsule-001.txt
          └─ capsule-001.png
  ```
- Persist a verified marker only after server-confirmed unlock; offline recipient reads require matching active UID, marker and retained bytes; sender A→B access uses its separate participant permission.
  - So basically:
  ```
  Server approves the unlock -> Save Verified Marker 
  -> Save the relevant protected contents/photos in local disk 
  -> Can open those contents/photos in offline state. 
  ```
  - When checking `OfflineReadAllowed`, we check:
    - Does the login account UID match with the content/photo owner account?
    - Does the verified marker exist for that capsule?
    - Does the protected contents/photo exists in local disk?
- On logout/switch, cancel listeners and account notifications, invalidate session generation, clear visible models, verified markers and protected files; EXCLUDE retained content and send snapshots from Android backup.
  - Basically a cleanup process when authenticated user session changes/ends.
- Keep only an opaque UID/ID/digest/status recovery journal across logout for uncertain sends, block old-session callbacks, and re-fetch/reconcile after the same UID signs in; AC-13 remains unexecuted.
  - Basically a journal for the activities whom its result is unsure. (Did it fail? or succeed?)

title.en: Android foreground, location, media and notification adapters

summary.en: Use Google Maps SDK for a confirmed map pin and FusedLocationProviderClient for fresh foreground samples; fixed distance/age/accuracy limits are 150 m/60 s/100 m, with no Places/geocoding.
summary.ko: 지도 핀과 최신 전경 위치를 사용하고 임계값은 150m·60초·100m입니다.

overview.en:
- Use Google Maps SDK for a confirmed map pin and FusedLocationProviderClient for fresh foreground samples; fixed distance/age/accuracy limits are 150 m/60 s/100 m, with no Places/geocoding.
- Use Photo Picker on API 33+ and ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT on API 26–32; validate and privately copy one original JPEG/PNG of at most 5 MiB before freezing a send.
- The MVP trigger set is app-open, foreground resume, detail opening and manual retry; no alarm, geofence, boot receiver, periodic worker, FCM or background-location registration is installed.
- NotificationManager attempts a generic account-scoped notification after a supported check confirms first unlock and permission permits; denial and missed delivery do not affect access.

summary.ko: 사용자 계정과 자기 자신 및 다른 계정으로의 직접 캡슐 전송·수신을 필수 범위로 유지한다.

overview.en:
- Use Auth UID as the public recipient code and directory document ID; display/copy it on Account.
- At registration collect a nonblank display name; create the profile idempotently after Auth success and repair a missing profile on the next signed-in launch.
- Allow the owner to correct only displayName; lookup another account with exact trimmed UID and confirm the returned name before freezing recipientId.
- Return NotFound only for an authoritative absent record; offline, denied or unavailable lookup keeps Send disabled and offers retry.
overview.ko:
계정 기반 A→A/A→B 전달은 MVP

overview.en:

- Accept only JPEG/PNG with declared and decoded format consistent, actual stream size 1..5,242,880 bytes and at most one selection.

- Freeze original bytes/hash/path in the send snapshot; do not add audio, camera, mandatory compression or multiple photos.

summary.en: Evaluate TIME, LOCATION and BOTH from the persisted lock fields; do not save historical timeOK/locationOK flags as unlock authority.
summary.ko: 시간, 위치, 두 조건을 모두 지원하며 최초 복합 해제는 현재 위치와 서버 시간의 AND이다.

overview.en:
- Evaluate TIME, LOCATION and BOTH from the persisted lock fields; do not save historical timeOK/locationOK flags as unlock authority.
- Use Location.elapsedRealtimeNanos against elapsed realtime for age and Location.distanceBetween for target distance; reject missing, nonfinite, negative-age or negative-accuracy samples.
- The location predicate is permission/service available AND age≤60 s AND accuracy≤100 m AND distance≤150 m; the backend supplies the decisive time predicate.
- For BOTH, recheck freshness immediately before an online transaction and do not retry with an expired sample; already-inside users may explicitly recheck.
overview.ko:
시간·위치·복합 AND 잠금

- The MVP uses no FCM, exact alarms or background discovery; users recover missed notifications and new deliveries by opening or refreshing the app.

summary.en: Use Firebase Android BoM 34.4.0 with firebase-auth, firebase-firestore and firebase-storage main modules, Google services Gradle plugin 4.4.4, and no separate Firebase KTX artifacts.
summary.ko: Firebase BoM 34.4.0과 google-services 4.4.4를 고정합니다.

overview.en:
- Use Firebase Android BoM 34.4.0 with firebase-auth, firebase-firestore and firebase-storage main modules, Google services Gradle plugin 4.4.4, and no separate Firebase KTX artifacts.

overview.en:

- After publication deny edits to recipient, content, title, photo path and lock conditions; self-send content remains locked in Sent as well as Received.

summary.en: Allocate a random capsule ID once at Send and derive the original photo path from sender UID and ID.
summary.ko: Send에서 무작위 ID를 한 번 만들고 발신자·ID 기반 사진 경로를 고정합니다.

overview.en:
- Allocate a random capsule ID once at Send and derive the original photo path from sender UID and ID.
- Compute SHA-256 over a versioned canonical UTF-8 snapshot containing recipient, title/text, lock fields and photo digest, excluding server-generated timestamps and unlock state.
- Reconcile by a server read and immutable-field comparison; replay after a lost operation uses the same ID/path/digest, while a mismatch is a conflict and never permission to overwrite.
- Repeated taps join one local operation; a deliberately new capsule gets a new random ID even when content matches, and uncertain publication never permits an edited new-ID restart.
overview.ko:
고정된 전송 ID와 결과 확인
Send에서 무작위 ID를 한 번 만들고 발신자·ID 기반 사진 경로를 고정합니다.
불변 스냅샷을 정규화한 SHA-256으로 기록 일치 여부를 확인합니다.
결과 불명 재시도는 같은 ID·경로·내용을 사용합니다.

summary.en: DRAFT permits edits; Send validates and persists the immutable snapshot before entering SENDING.
summary.ko: Send 후 완료·결과 불명 동안 편집을 막고 확정 실패 후 편집하려면 새 논리 작업을 시작한다. 팀 승인 필요.

overview.en:
- DRAFT permits edits; Send validates and persists the immutable snapshot before entering SENDING.
- SENDING and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN disable editing and new-ID retry; an upload ACK alone does not enable SENT.
- An unavailable or absent reconciliation read leaves uncertainty when a prior write may still arrive; resolve by acknowledged matching publication or a known terminated/rejected operation.
- After definite failure allow same-ID unchanged retry, or abandon then clone into a new editable draft/new ID; purge self-send raw display buffers when publication is confirmed.
  - Purge activity is required to not let the protected content show even after SENDING via app UI.

title.ko: 사진 업로드 후 Firestore 최종 발행 제안

summary.en: Upload the validated original to the stable private path and await Storage completion before the final Firestore batch.
summary.ko: 필요 사진 업로드 ACK 후 메타데이터와 보호 본문을 하나의 Firestore batch로 발행한다. 실제 통합 검증 필요.

overview.en:
- Upload the validated original to the stable private path and await Storage completion before the final Firestore batch.
- Create capsules/{id} and protectedContent/{id} together; getAfter predicates require the paired document, matching ownership/digest and correct initial locked state.
- SENT means server ACK or matching server-read publication; queue metadata and local hasPendingWrites=false alone are insufficient proof.
- Firestore cannot prove Storage object existence atomically: the official sender enforces upload ACK, AC-14 tests interruption, and stronger server orchestration is outside this MVP.

title.ko: 서버 시간 발행 검증·단방향 해제 제안

summary.en: Start only online using an authenticated recipient and server-read metadata; recheck a current sample for LOCATION/BOTH in the live attempt.
summary.ko: 미래 unlockAt 조건을 서버에서 검사하고 권한 있는 수신자만 LOCKED→UNLOCKED를 허용한다. Rules 검증 필요.

overview.en:
- Start only online using an authenticated recipient and server-read metadata; recheck a current sample for LOCATION/BOTH in the live attempt.
- Run a Firestore transaction that leaves immutable fields unchanged and sets unlocked=true plus unlockedAt=serverTimestamp only from false.
- Rules enforce recipient identity, changed-key allowlist, request.time equality for unlockedAt and TIME/BOTH request.time≥unlockAt; an already true record is a successful idempotent read.
- Do not enqueue offline location intent or silently retry with an aged sample; on lost ACK reconcile from server, and on denial keep content hidden with a retry explanation.
overview.ko:

summary.en: Persist {uid,capsuleId,verifiedUnlockedAt} only from a server-confirmed recipient unlock, then retain downloaded bytes in that UID's private directory.
summary.ko: 서버 확정 해제 이력을 활성 UID별로 기록하고 오프라인 데이터 격리를 검증한다. 실패하면 메모리 캐시 등으로 변경한다.

overview.en:
- Persist {uid,capsuleId,verifiedUnlockedAt} only from a server-confirmed recipient unlock, then retain downloaded bytes in that UID's private directory.
- Require active-session UID and marker before every offline read; A→B sender access is tracked separately and never grants A→A recipient access.
- On logout/switch invalidate the generation first, cancel work/listeners, blank screens and purge former-account protected files/markers; discard late callbacks before cache or UI writes.
- Exclude app-private protected data from backup; keep uncertain-send IDs/digests only for later same-account reconciliation, with no body/photo rendering path.

summary.ko: Firebase 이메일·비밀번호 인증과 UID 수신자 코드를 사용합니다.

overview.en:
- Use Firebase Auth email/password only; registration collects a nonblank displayName and the Auth UID is the public recipient code.
- After Auth success, create recipientDirectory/{uid} idempotently with uid/displayName; a missing profile routes to the same repair form and retry, with capsule sending disabled until the profile exists.
- The owner may correct displayName only; authenticated exact document get is allowed, directory list is denied, and another recipient requires explicit name/code confirmation after every edit of input for UID search.
- Sign-in errors distinguish invalid credentials from unavailable service; Auth state drives logout/session cleanup, and password reset, email-verification gating and social sign-in are excluded from this MVP.
overview.ko:
이메일·비밀번호 계정과 정확한 수신자 프로필
Firebase 이메일·비밀번호 인증과 UID 수신자 코드를 사용합니다.
프로필 생성 실패 시 복구 폼에서 재시도하며 프로필 완성 전 전송을 막습니다.
소유자만 표시 이름을 수정하고, 코드가 바뀌면 수신자 확인을 다시 받습니다.

summary.en: Use one dedicated team-owned Firebase project for the MVP on Blaze; choose Firestore Standard/Native mode with its default database and the default Cloud Storage bucket in asia-northeast3 (Seoul).
summary.ko: 팀 전용 Firebase 프로젝트 하나를 Blaze 요금제로 사용하고 Firestore·Storage는 서울 리전을 선택합니다.

overview.en:
- Use one dedicated team-owned Firebase project for the MVP on Blaze; choose Firestore Standard/Native mode with its default database and the default Cloud Storage bucket in asia-northeast3 (Seoul).
- Register the production Android application as com.timecapsule.app; enable email/password Auth and Maps SDK for Android in that project, and run automated backend tests against local Firebase emulators.
- Version firebase.json, firestore.rules, storage.rules and firestore.indexes.json together; deploy both rulesets before production use, with participant equality queries and default single-field indexes, without compound orderBy queries.
- Load the actual Firebase project/app IDs from generated google-services.json and the Maps key from a Gradle property into the manifest; missing configuration fails the production build, and keys are restricted to the application ID and signing-certificate SHA-1.
overview.ko:

팀 전용 Firebase 프로젝트 하나를 Blaze 요금제로 사용하고 Firestore·Storage는 서울 리전을 선택합니다.
프로덕션 applicationId는 com.timecapsule.app이며 이메일 인증과 Android Maps SDK를 사용합니다.
규칙·인덱스를 버전 관리하고 실제 프로젝트 설정과 제한된 지도 키를 빌드에 주입합니다.

summary.en: Persist the immutable snapshot, random capsule ID, photo path/digest and operation phase before network work; serialize local work for each capsule ID.
summary.ko: 불변 스냅샷과 ID·경로·해시를 저장하고 사진 ACK 후 원자적 최종 게시를 수행합니다.

overview.en:
- Persist the immutable snapshot, random capsule ID, photo path/digest and operation phase before network work; serialize local work for each capsule ID.
- Upload the original photo when present, await its ACK, then create metadata and protected content in one atomic batch with create-only rules; explicit terminal rejection is FAILED and ambiguous acknowledgement is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
- Reconcile with a server read: a matching record is SENT, a conflicting record is an error, and unavailable/absent results do not authorize abandonment while an earlier write can still publish; an unchanged replay always reuses the original ID, path and digest.
  - Basically: 

  | Server check result | Handle as |
  | --- | --- |
  | Post exists with same ID and snapshot | SENT |
  | Post exists with same ID but different snapshot | Conflict error |
  | Can't access server | Keep OUTCOME_UNKNOWN |
  | No such post but it could arrive soon to server | Keep OUTCOME_UNKNOWN |
- Retry the retained SDK task while it exists; after process restart and an authoritative absent read, replay only the same frozen operation, then reconcile an already-exists rejection; editing/new ID is allowed only after a definite unpublished failure.
overview.ko:
확정·불확실 전송 결과 확인
불변 스냅샷과 ID·경로·해시를 저장하고 사진 ACK 후 원자적 최종 게시를 수행합니다.
응답 불명은 결과 확인 상태로 유지하며 서버의 일치 기록으로만 성공을 확정합니다.
재시도는 동일 ID와 내용을 사용하고 확정 미게시 실패 뒤에만 새 초안으로 편집합니다.

summary.en: Use Google Maps SDK 19.2.0 for pin selection and FusedLocationProviderClient from play-services-location 21.3.0 for current position; store finite latitude in [-90,90] and longitude in [-180,180].
summary.ko: Maps SDK 19.2.0과 위치 서비스 21.3.0을 사용합니다.

overview.en:
- Use Google Maps SDK 19.2.0 for pin selection and FusedLocationProviderClient from play-services-location 21.3.0 for current position; store finite latitude in [-90,90] and longitude in [-180,180].
- Request foreground coarse/fine location together when the user chooses current position or checks a location lock; manual map-pin selection remains available without location permission, and background location is never requested.
- Acquire with getCurrentLocation at high accuracy, then validate elapsed-realtime age≤60 s, reported accuracy≤100 m and distance≤150 m immediately before the online unlock attempt; missing/stale/poor samples retain the lock.
- Use fixed thresholds for this MVP, no dwell or historical latch, no Places/geocoding and no anti-spoof claim; a Google Play-enabled API 36 emulator and an Android physical phone are the specified integration targets.
overview.ko:
지도 대상과 현재 위치 구현
Maps SDK 19.2.0과 위치 서비스 21.3.0을 사용합니다.
전경 위치 권한만 요청하고 지도 핀은 권한 없이도 선택할 수 있습니다.
거리 150m·샘플 수명 60초·정확도 100m를 고정하며 과거 방문은 저장하지 않습니다.

title.en: UTC publication and one-way unlock rules
title.ko: UTC 게시 및 단방향 잠금 해제 규칙

summary.en: Convert the selected local date/time with its IANA ZoneId to an Instant; reject daylight-saving gaps and require an explicit offset for overlaps, preserving UTC Timestamp plus creationZoneId.
summary.ko: 선택 시각은 생성 시간대와 UTC 절대 시각으로 저장합니다.

overview.en:
- Convert the selected local date/time with its IANA ZoneId to an Instant; reject daylight-saving gaps and require an explicit offset for overlaps, preserving UTC Timestamp plus creationZoneId.
- On TIME/BOTH creation, Firestore rules require unlockAt > request.time; creation starts locked and requires the paired metadata/protected-content documents and matching immutable identity/digest.
- Only the authenticated recipient may transition unlocked=false to true, changing only unlocked/unlockedAt with unlockedAt==request.time and the TIME/BOTH time gate request.time≥unlockAt.
- Use an online Firestore transaction and a freshly validated client location for LOCATION/BOTH; transaction retries revalidate sample age, cached/pending writes cannot authorize reads, and confirmed true never changes back to false.
overview.ko:
UTC 게시 및 단방향 잠금 해제 규칙
선택 시각은 생성 시간대와 UTC 절대 시각으로 저장합니다.
게시 시 미래 시각을 서버가 검사하고 수신자만 허용된 필드를 단방향 변경합니다.
위치·시간 결합은 최신 위치와 온라인 트랜잭션으로 평가하며 확인된 해제는 되돌리지 않습니다.

title.ko: 전경 검증 및 알림 실행 조건

summary.en: For this MVP, verify on app-open, foreground resume, capsule-detail opening and explicit Retry; these are the complete production trigger set.
summary.ko: 앱 열기·전경 복귀·상세 화면·명시적 재시도만 이번 MVP의 실행 조건으로 사용합니다.

overview.en:
- For this MVP, verify on app-open, foreground resume, capsule-detail opening and explicit Retry; these are the complete production trigger set.
- Do not register AlarmManager alarms, geofences, boot receivers, WorkManager polling, background location or FCM; process death/reboot recovery occurs when the user next opens the app.
- After a supported foreground check confirms first unlock, attempt one local NotificationManager notification per account/capsule when POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission is granted on applicable APIs.
- Use generic notification text and an account-scoped pending intent through ordinary auth/detail checks; denial or missed delivery never affects access, and no closed-app or exact-time alert is promised.
overview.ko:
전경 검증 및 알림 실행 조건
앱 열기·전경 복귀·상세 화면·명시적 재시도만 이번 MVP의 실행 조건으로 사용합니다.

첫 해제 확인 후 권한이 있으면 계정·캡슐별 로컬 알림을 한 번 시도합니다.

summary.en: On API 33+ use Android Photo Picker for one image; on API 26–32 use ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT with OPENABLE, then enforce JPEG/PNG, 1..5,242,880 actual bytes and matching decodable format.
summary.ko: API 33 이상은 Photo Picker, API 26–32는 문서 선택기를 사용합니다.

overview.en:
- On API 33+ use Android Photo Picker for one image; on API 26–32 use ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT with OPENABLE, then enforce JPEG/PNG, 1..5,242,880 actual bytes and matching decodable format.
- Always stream the chosen original into a byte-capped app-private copy and compute SHA-256 before Send; the frozen operation uses that copy, so retry does not depend on continuing URI permission.
- Use authenticated Storage SDK access at capsuleMedia/{senderUid}/{capsuleId}/original; require upload ACK before publication, match text/photo read ACLs and deny overwrite/delete after publication.
- Purge draft buffers after confirmed publication or definite abandonment; delete remote unreferenced uploads only for a definitely failed/abandoned operation with no outstanding write, never during an uncertain result, and perform cleanup on foreground recovery without a daemon.
overview.ko:
원본 사진 선택·재시도·정리
API 33 이상은 Photo Picker, API 26–32는 문서 선택기를 사용합니다.
JPEG/PNG 원본 하나를 5MiB 이하로 검증하고 앱 전용 사본과 SHA-256을 저장합니다.
사진 ACK 후 게시하며 결과 불명 중에는 원격 파일을 정리하지 않습니다.

summary.en: Welcome → register/sign in → repair missing profile if necessary → synchronize active-account Sent/Received lists.

overview.en:
- Welcome → register/sign in → repair missing profile if necessary → synchronize active-account Sent/Received lists.
- Account displays and copies the UID and edits displayName; choosing another recipient requires exact code, returned name and explicit confirmation.
- Lookup absent, unavailable and denied states have distinct explanations; stale identity confirmation clears when the code changes.
- Logout/switch clears protected screens and previous-account retained data before entering the next session.

- Content permits optional disclosed title, message and/or one photo; Lock offers Time, Location or Both with confirmed instant/coordinates.
- Review shows recipient identity, title visibility and exact lock; Send freezes ID/snapshot and presents sending, confirmed success, definite failure or outcome unknown.
- Unknown offers status reconciliation; definite failure offers unchanged retry or a new edited draft; success opens a safe list/detail route.

title.en: Account, public code and session isolation

summary.en: Valid registration/sign-in/sign-out succeeds; invalid credentials and expired/signed-out remote access are rejected.
summary.ko: 가입·로그인·로그아웃과 잘못된 인증정보/세션을 확인한다. 타 계정 및 로그아웃 상태에서 보호 데이터 접근을 거부하고 계정 전환 후 이전 계정 정보가 보이지 않아야 한다. 비밀번호 재설정·이메일 인증은 별도 승인 전 필수가 아니다.

overview.en:
- Valid registration/sign-in/sign-out succeeds; invalid credentials and expired/signed-out remote access are rejected.
- The current user can view/copy its exact UID and create/correct only its own displayName; missing profile creation can be retried safely.
- Switching accounts or relaunching after logout shows no former-account records, content or late asynchronous results.
- Password reset and email verification are not added MVP acceptance commitments.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

가입/로그인/로그아웃의 성공과 잘못된 자격증명/세션 동작을 확인한다. 다른 사용자나 로그아웃 상태의 읽기를 거부한다. 계정 전환 시 이전 계정 기록이 보이지 않는다. 비밀번호 재설정/이메일 인증은 나중에 승인하지 않는 한 **새 인수 약속이 아니다**.

summary.en: Accept text-only, one-photo-only or both with a confirmed recipient and Time/Location/Both; reject neither, absent lock or invalid recipient.
summary.ko: 텍스트·사진·복합 내용과 잠금 유형의 유효 조합을 허용하고 빈 내용·잠금 누락·지원 불가 사진은 거절한다. 초안만 수정 가능하고 Send 후 결과 확인까지 스냅샷과 ID를 고정한다. 완료 후 수정·삭제 불가, 확정 실패는 같은 내용 재시도 또는 새 ID 초안을 허용한다.

overview.en:
- Accept text-only, one-photo-only or both with a confirmed recipient and Time/Location/Both; reject neither, absent lock or invalid recipient.
- Title may be empty; an entered title carries a visible pre-unlock disclosure in composition/review and does not satisfy the content requirement.
- Accept readable JPEG/PNG up to 5,242,880 bytes, including the exact boundary; reject additional, unsupported, unreadable, empty or oversize media.
- Only DRAFT is editable; sending/unknown freeze ID and snapshot, SENT is immutable, and edited restart follows definite failure with a new ID.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

유효한 수신자와 시간 또는 위치 조건이 있으면 텍스트만/사진만/둘 다를 허용한다. 둘 다 없음/잠금 없음은 거부한다. 5 MiB 경계를 포함하여 미지원·읽기 불가·용량 초과 사진을 거부하고 입력한 데이터를 보존한다. `DRAFT`는 수정 가능하다. Send는 스냅샷을 고정하고 `SENDING`/`OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` 중 수정을 비활성화한다. `SENT`가 확인된 뒤에는 수정/삭제할 수 없다. 확정 실패 작업은 같은 스냅샷 재시도 또는 포기 후 새 작업 ID의 수정 가능한 초안을 제공한다. 결과 불명 상태에서 중복 생성하지 않도록 한다.

summary.en: A valid exact UID returns a minimal profile and requires identity confirmation; blank/absent codes block Send and service unavailability is distinct.
summary.ko: A→A/A→B 각각 하나의 논리 캡슐로 전달된다. UID 정확 조회·이름 확인을 제공하며 존재하지 않음과 조회 불가를 구분한다. 원격 최종 기록·필요 사진의 ACK 전에 SENT가 아니며 B 앱 열기는 발신 완료 조건이 아니다. 같은 작업 재시도는 ID 재사용, 별도 동일 내용 작성은 허용한다.

overview.en:
- A valid exact UID returns a minimal profile and requires identity confirmation; blank/absent codes block Send and service unavailability is distinct.
- A→A and A→B produce one underlying capsule per logical operation; deliberate new capsules may have identical content and different IDs.
- SENT requires necessary media upload ACK plus final backend publication ACK or a matching server-confirmed record; local pending state does not qualify.
- B discovers the record through its authorized app-open query without a sender-side B handshake or FCM.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

A→A와 A→B는 올바른 수신자에게 하나의 원본 캡슐을 전달한다. 신원 확인을 포함한 정확한 등록 UID 조회는 성공하고, 잘못된/빈 코드는 차단한다. 조회 불가와 계정 미존재를 구분한다. 미디어가 있다면 미디어 완료 및 백엔드 최종 기록 ACK 이후에만 `SENT`이다. 로컬 대기 쓰기/타임아웃은 `SENT`가 아니다. 발신자가 B의 앱 실행을 기다리지 않아도 수신자 쿼리가 가능하다. 동일 작업 재시도는 ID/경로를 재사용하여 중복을 만들지 않으며, 내용이 같아도 별도로 만든 전송은 유효하다.

summary.en: TIME/BOTH publication rejects unlockAt≤backend request.time; a future UTC instant and creation IANA zone are preserved.
summary.ko: 미래 설정만 수락하고 최종 발행 시 서버 request.time 이하 unlockAt을 거부한다. 잠금 전 보호 콘텐츠 접근을 차단하며 시간 이후 온라인 확인으로 해제할 수 있다. 기기 시각·시간대 변경으로 조건을 우회하지 않고 UTC instant·생성 시간대 정보를 유지한다.

overview.en:
- TIME/BOTH publication rejects unlockAt≤backend request.time; a future UTC instant and creation IANA zone are preserved.
- Protected first reads fail before the deadline and succeed only after online server-authorized unlock at or after it.
- Changing device clock or zone neither changes the stored instant nor permits early unlock; offline first unlock remains protected.
- Daylight-saving gaps are rejected and overlaps require an explicit offset choice reflected in review.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

미래 시각은 성공한다. 최종 발행 시 `unlockAt ≤ backend request.time`이면 거부한다. 기한 전에는 잠긴 콘텐츠에 접근할 수 없고, 기기 시계와 무관하게 서버 시각이 기한 이상이면 온라인 최초 해제가 가능하다. 표시용 시간대 메타데이터를 유지하고 기기 시간대 변경이 `unlockAt`을 바꾸지 않는다. 오프라인 최초 해제는 안전하게 실패한다.

summary.en: Confirmed map/current-position coordinates persist; no geocoding or address-search result is required.
summary.ko: 지도 지정/현재 위치의 좌표가 저장된다. 거리 ≤150m, 샘플 나이 ≤60초, 정확도 ≤100m일 때만 온라인 최초 해제를 시도한다. 외부·오래됨·부정확·권한 거부·위치 서비스 해제 및 ENTER 이벤트 단독으로는 해제 불가이며 실기기 검증 후 임계치를 조정한다.

overview.en:
- Confirmed map/current-position coordinates persist; no geocoding or address-search result is required.
- The boundary distance=150 m, sample age=60 s and accuracy=100 m qualifies when all other checks and online confirmation succeed.
- Outside, stale, nonfinite, missing or negative fields, poor accuracy, denied permission or disabled service do not qualify and show recovery guidance.
- ENTER alone cannot unlock; real-device evidence is required before changing the existing thresholds.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

지도 지점/현재 위치 좌표가 유지된다. 반경=150 m, 표본 경과 시간≤60초, 정확도≤100 m 조건에서 범위 안이면 온라인 최초 해제를 허용한다. 범위 밖/오래된 표본/낮은 정확도/위치 서비스 비활성화/권한 거부 시에는 허용하지 않는다. ENTER 하나만으로 해제하지 않는다. 임계값을 재조정하기 전에 실기기 증거가 필요하며, Places/지오코딩은 인수 요구사항이 아니다.

summary.ko: 해제 전 F/F·F/T·T/F는 잠금, T/T와 온라인 확인일 때만 해제한다. 시간 전 방문 후 이탈은 불인정; 시간 도달 시 이미 안에 있으면 최신 위치 재확인으로 해제 가능. 해제 후 이탈해도 재잠금하지 않는다.

overview.en:
- Before first unlock, F/F, F/T and T/F remain locked; T/T in the same valid online attempt can unlock.
- A visit before the deadline followed by departure does not count; already-inside users can recheck after the deadline without a new ENTER.
- Expired samples, offline queued intent and past true flags cannot authorize a later attempt; acquire/revalidate current location again.
- After backend confirmation, departure, timezone changes and repeated checks never reverse UNLOCKED.

**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

최초 해제 전 진리표 F/F, F/T, T/F에서는 잠긴 채 유지하고, T/T이면서 온라인 확인을 받으면 해제한다. 기한 전 방문 후 떠났으면 실패한다. 기한 뒤에도 안에 머물며 새 현재 위치 검사에 통과하면 성공한다. 해제 후 이탈해도 다시 잠기지 않는다.

summary.en: When a time-only callback is missed, app-open/resume/detail/Retry after the deadline recovers through online verification.
summary.ko: 알림·백그라운드 이벤트를 누락해도 시간 경과 후 앱 재실행과 온라인 확인으로 복구한다. 기한 전 또는 오프라인 상태는 잠김을 유지하고 안내한다. 복합 조건은 현재 위치까지 확인해야 한다.

overview.en:
- When a time-only callback is missed, app-open/resume/detail/Retry after the deadline recovers through online verification.
- Before the deadline the same path stays locked; a combined lock also needs a qualifying current location.
- Offline or unknown first verification shows verification-required without protected content, and a later valid online retry recovers.
- Concurrent or late checks cannot authorize a different session or account.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

누락/지연 백그라운드 이벤트를 억제한 뒤 시간 기한 후 재실행하면 온라인으로 검증하여 시간 전용 캡슐을 해제한다. 기한 전 재실행은 잠긴 채 유지한다. 오프라인 최초 해제는 검증 필요를 표시하며 온라인 재시도로 복구한다. 복합 조건에서 위치가 현재/유효하지 않으면 잠긴 채 유지한다.

summary.en: A successful online first-unlock check from app-open, resume, detail or Retry attempts one local notification when permission allows it.
summary.ko: 전경의 첫 잠금 해제 확인 후 권한이 있으면 로컬 알림을 한 번 시도합니다.

overview.en:
- A successful online first-unlock check from app-open, resume, detail or Retry attempts one local notification when permission allows it.
- Denied, delayed or omitted notification delivery never crashes the app or changes eligibility, and repeated sync does not repeatedly notify the same account/capsule.
- Tapping the notification rechecks the active account and confirmed state; its preview contains no protected body or photo.
- The production manifest contains no background-location permission, alarm/geofence/boot receiver or periodic polling registration; no closed-app or exact-time notification is required.

전경 알림 수용 기준
전경의 첫 잠금 해제 확인 후 권한이 있으면 로컬 알림을 한 번 시도합니다.
알림 실패·지연·거절은 접근 권한에 영향을 주지 않습니다.
백그라운드 권한·알람·지오펜스·부팅 수신기·주기 등록은 없어야 합니다.

title.en: Permanent access and conditional offline re-view

summary.en: Confirmed unlocked text/photo remain readable online after reentry, relaunch, departure and another authorized session/device.
summary.ko: 한 번 해제된 본문·사진은 화면 재진입·재실행·위치 이탈 후 온라인에서 계속 열람할 수 있다. 오프라인은 사전 보유한 같은 계정 파일에 한하며 누락 시 재다운로드 안내를 보여준다. 계정 전환 시 다른 계정 콘텐츠가 보이면 안 된다.

overview.en:
- Confirmed unlocked text/photo remain readable online after reentry, relaunch, departure and another authorized session/device.
- Offline re-view succeeds only for previously retained current-account assets with confirmed access provenance.
- An absent retained photo/text shows an unavailable/download-retry explanation without relocking the remote capsule.
- Other-account, signed-out and locked self-send views never obtain retained protected content.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

해제가 확인된 텍스트/사진은 재진입·재실행·위치 이탈 후에도 온라인으로 열람할 수 있다. 오프라인 재열람은 같은 계정이 **미리 보유한** 자료에서 동작한다. 자료가 없으면 다시 내려받아야 함을 설명한다. 계정 전환 시 이전 사용자가 보유한 콘텐츠를 절대 표시하지 않는다.

summary.ko: 사진 읽기·업로드, 네트워크·위치·권한·서버 거부 오류를 정확한 실패/결과 불명 상태로 안내하고 가능한 복구 경로를 제공한다. 최초 검증이 실패한 상태에서 보호 콘텐츠가 노출되지 않는다.

overview.en:
- Photo read/upload, network, backend rejection, permission and location-service failures show their actual error class and feasible recovery.
- Recipient absent and lookup unavailable differ; definite failure and uncertain publication differ; pending sends never appear successful.
- First-verification failure keeps body/photo hidden; a post-unlock asset failure displays missing content without crashing.
- Native screens remain navigable with keyboard/insets, readable text and labeled controls; local simulation is visibly identified.

title.ko: 목록·앱 실행 시 새 수신 조회

summary.en: Separate Sent/Received lists show participant-authorized metadata including a disclosed optional title, with no protected text/photo preview.
summary.ko: 보낸/받은 목록에 허가된 기록만 나타난다. A→A는 하나의 원격 ID로 양쪽 목록에 표시된다. B가 앱을 열면 새 A→B 기록이 동기화된다. 미완료 전송을 SENT로 표시하지 않고 오프라인 목록의 오래됨을 안내한다.

overview.en:
- Separate Sent/Received lists show participant-authorized metadata including a disclosed optional title, with no protected text/photo preview.
- A→A appears in both views using the same underlying ID; sender A→B content access is distinct from recipient B's locked view.
- B discovers a newly published A→B capsule on app-open/refresh; failed/unknown operations are not successful recipient deliveries.
- Offline lists are marked possibly stale and clear when the active account changes.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

별도의 보낸/받은 목록은 허용된 캡슐만 표시한다. A→A는 원격 기록을 복제하지 않고 두 목록에 나타난다. B는 앱 실행 동기화 후 A→B를 발견한다. 대기/실패 항목을 `SENT`로 잘못 표시하지 않는다. 캐시/오프라인 목록은 오래되었을 수 있다고 표시한다.

summary.en: Rules tests deny locked B and locked A→A protected text/photo, permit A→B sender and unlocked recipient, and deny C/signed-out access.
summary.ko: 에뮬레이터에서 잠긴 수신자·A→A 본문/사진·관련 없는 C·로그아웃 사용자를 차단한다. A→B 발신자와 확인된 해제 수신자는 허용한다. 발신자/수신자/잠금 조건 변경·조기 UNLOCKED·역방향 상태변경을 차단하고 서버 시간 기준을 적용한다. 위치 위조 방어는 MVP 보장 대상이 아니다.

overview.en:
- Rules tests deny locked B and locked A→A protected text/photo, permit A→B sender and unlocked recipient, and deny C/signed-out access.
- Reject forged ownership, participant/condition/content/title changes, early unlock, relock and unauthorized unlock; validate server timestamps and changed-key allowlists.
- Atomic creation requires paired metadata/protected documents and matching immutable digest/identity; one-sided or mismatched publication is rejected.
- Storage path reads match text ACL and finalized overwrite/delete is denied; client-trusted physical presence and cross-product object-existence limits remain explicit.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

Firebase 에뮬레이터 규칙 테스트에서 (i) 해제 전 B는 보호 텍스트/사진을 가져올 수 없고, (ii) A→B의 발신자 A는 가능하며, (iii) A→A의 발신자/수신자는 해제 전 접근할 수 없고, (iv) 무관한 C/로그아웃 사용자는 거부되며, (v) 인가된 단방향 전환 외의 `senderId`·수신자·조건·시간·해제 상태 위조는 거부되고, (vi) 클라이언트가 시계/위치에 대해 거짓말해도 백엔드 시간 게이트를 우회할 수 없어야 한다. **위치 전용/복합 조건에서는 이 MVP의 서버가 클라이언트 위치의 정직성을 검증할 수 없다. 위치 위조 방지를 주장하지 말고 이 한계를 별도로 기록한다.**

summary.en: After confirmed unlock and download, retained content is available offline only to the matching active UID.
summary.ko: 서버에서 해제 확인한 캡슐의 실제 보유 파일만 해당 계정이 오프라인에서 다시 볼 수 있다. 오프라인 계정 전환·로그아웃·재실행 시 이전 계정의 본문·사진·리스너가 다른 계정 화면에 노출되지 않아야 한다. 디스크 캐시가 통과하지 못하면 캐시 방식을 변경한다.

overview.en:
- After confirmed unlock and download, retained content is available offline only to the matching active UID.
- Offline logout/switch/relaunch and late old-session callbacks cannot show or restore former-account protected data or notifications.
- The memory-only Firestore strategy plus explicit retained files clears app-managed markers/content on logout and excludes protected state from backup.
- Self-send publication removes raw sender display paths; unresolved-send journals retain only opaque recovery metadata across logout.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

이전에 해제가 검증된 콘텐츠가 보유되어 있으면 현재 계정은 오프라인 재열람할 수 있다. 오프라인 계정 전환/로그아웃/재실행 동안 A의 보호 데이터가 B에게 표시되지 않으며 앱 관리 보호 파일/리스너를 정리한다. 선택한 Firestore 디스크 캐시가 격리 테스트에 실패하면 이 기준을 통과로 표시하기 전에 캐시 전략을 수정한다.

summary.en: Inject failure before/after Storage ACK, final batch submission, backend commit and ACK; also restart the process and reconnect.
summary.ko: 사진 업로드 전후와 최종 Firestore 기록 ACK 전후에 장애·타임아웃을 주입한다. 결과 불명은 같은 capsuleId로 조회·재시도하여 중복 없이 완료하거나 확정 실패를 안내한다. 필수 사진 없는 캡슐을 발행 성공으로 표시하지 않으며 Storage와 Firestore가 단일 트랜잭션이라는 잘못된 보장은 하지 않는다.

overview.en:
- Inject failure before/after Storage ACK, final batch submission, backend commit and ACK; also restart the process and reconnect.
- One logical operation retains ID/path/digest and yields one confirmed matching publication or a definite recoverable failure, never a split public/content record.
- An absent read with an outstanding delayed write remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; no edited new-ID retry is offered until the original is definitively resolved.
- The official sender does not claim usable photo delivery without upload ACK; wrong/missing objects and orphan handling have explicit recovery evidence.
overview.ko:
**v0.3 한국어 참고 기록 — 현행 2026-10-31 상세 계약은 영어 탭을 참조하세요.**

사진 업로드 후, 캡슐 batch 쓰기 ACK 전/후, 그리고 재연결 후 타임아웃을 주입한다. `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`은 `capsuleId`로 대조·확정한다. 결국 하나의 논리적 `SENT` 기록과 허용된 사진을 발견하거나, 확정적이고 복구 가능한 실패를 보고한다. 필수 사진이 없는 캡슐을 공식 발신 흐름에서 성공이라 선언하지 않는다. 최종 확정된 캡슐 기록이 발행되기 전에는 사진과 보호 텍스트가 수신자에게 보이지 않는다. Cloud Storage와 Firestore 간 서비스 간 원자성을 주장하지 않는다.

title.en: Delayed publication, process death and same-ID replay

overview.en:
- Arrange a final write with delayed commit/ACK and an authoritative absent read before that original write arrives.
- Kill/relaunch the process, replay only the frozen operation with the original ID/path/digest after the absent read, and then allow the delayed original to arrive; repeat explicit terminal rejection recovery.
- Assert one matching publication, already-exists reconciliation, no false definite failure from absence and no edited/new-ID retry while uncertain; an edited draft follows only a definite unpublished failure.
- Capture request IDs, stored payload digests and backend responses; execution status: NOT RUN.
